  {"step":1,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"Data[0]","code":"i = get_platform_entry((uint8_t)Data[0]);","note":"The first attacker-controlled byte selects the architecture/mode entry used for decoding."},
  {"step":2,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"Data+1","code":"count = cs_disasm(handle, Data+1, Size-1, address, 0, &all_insn);","note":"The remaining attacker-controlled bytes are passed to Capstone for disassembly."},
  {"step":3,"file":"arch/AArch64/AArch64Disassembler.c","function":"_getInstruction","line":230,"var":"MI->flat_insn->detail","code":"memset(MI->flat_insn->detail, 0, offsetof(cs_detail, arm64)+sizeof(cs_arm64));","note":"AArch64 detail storage is zeroed before decoding, so any later uninitialized read must come from fields that are not fully written by the printer path."},
  {"step":4,"file":"arch/AArch64/AArch64InstPrinter.c","function":"AArch64_printInst","line":1071,"var":"MI->flat_insn->detail->arm64.operands[MI->flat_insn->detail->arm64.op_count - 1].shift.type","code":"MI->flat_insn->detail->arm64.operands[MI->flat_insn->detail->arm64.op_count - 1].shift.type = ARM64_SFT_LSL;","note":"The printer updates only selected fields of the last operand while formatting certain AArch64 instructions, leaving other operand subfields dependent on prior initialization state."},
  {"step":5,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":53,"var":"detail->regs_read_count / detail->regs_write_count / detail->groups_count","code":"fprintf(outfile, ... detail->regs_read_count ... detail->regs_write_count ... detail->groups_count ...);","note":"The fuzz target consumes the populated detail structure after disassembly, which is where MemorySanitizer reports any uninitialized bytes that survived instruction printing."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print('updated trace')
